slide1.headline: Gap in AI Adoption for Physical Security
slide1.subtitle: According to Verkada's Report

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 12 Aug 2026
Verkada's 2026 State of Cloud Physical Security Report reveals a gap in AI adoption.
The report highlights the need for increased AI adoption in physical security.
64% of organizations have not implemented AI-powered physical security solutions.
This gap in adoption may leave organizations vulnerable to security threats.

slide3.title: WHY IT MATTERS
lines: The gap in AI adoption for physical security may have significant consequences.
Organizations that do not adopt AI-powered physical security solutions may be at risk.
AI can enhance physical security by providing real-time monitoring and threat detection.
The report emphasizes the importance of addressing this gap in AI adoption.

slide4.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The report highlights the need for increased awareness about the benefits of AI in physical security.
Organizations must invest in AI-powered physical security solutions to stay secure.
The gap in AI adoption is a concern that needs to be addressed promptly.
